hens_rule_text: backyard chickens are not allowed in the city of Irvine
permit_notes: No residential backyard-chicken permit path found; the city's poultry and rabbits code section appears to be a prohibition rather than a permit scheme.
setback_notes: Not applicable on ordinary residential lots.
coop_rules: Not applicable on ordinary residential lots.
zoning_notes: Irvine Municipal Code Title 4, Division 5, Chapter 9 (Livestock and Poultry), Sec. 4-5-902 'Poultry and rabbits' governs this; multiple secondary summaries (Your Orange County, backyardchickens.com, texasrealfood) agree Irvine prohibits backyard chickens, unlike neighboring Orange County cities such as Anaheim, Orange and Newport Beach which allow limited hens.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: Irvine Municipal Code, Title 4 Div. 5 Ch. 9, Sec. 4-5-902 Poultry and rabbits (Municode)

research_notes: library.municode.com is region-blocked from this machine so the code text itself could not be read; the ban is corroborated by two independent secondary summaries and matches the code section name (poultry and rabbits under livestock code), but the exact prohibition wording is unverified.
